parsing_traps: Statement of Total Return (p127) 'Rental and other income' S$100,531k is the gross_revenue anchor; includes S$3,926k variable rent and S$7,446k straight-lining adjustment (Note 16, p173). Note 16 rental-income line is S$100,526k + S$5k dividend income from share trading = S$100,531k.
Below-NPI income items (finance income S$269k) correctly placed as line_items revenue but NOT counted as gross_revenue/total_revenue; total_revenue = S$100,531k matches performance.gross_revenue.

Property cards (pp.29-43) 'FY2025 Rental Income' is a marketing figure in S$ millions (1 dp), excludes FRS116 straight-lining; sum approximates but does not equal audited Note 16 total. Used for per-property gross_revenue (illustrative). Two Japan cards (Ishiyama, Tsukisamu Koen) are on pp.27-28 not parsed in this range; their gross_revenue left null.
Imperial Aryaduta Hotel & Country Club: divested Dec 2025; carrying value nil in Portfolio Statement (FY2024 S$27,723k). Status = divested.

Combined assets with two leases: SHMD+HAMD (hospital 2035 / hotel 2027), SHKP+LPK (hospital 2035 / mall 2030), SHBB+LPB (hospital 2035 / mall 2032) — earlier expiry recorded in lease_expiry_date per REFERENCE convention; both in tenure_raw.
Trade mix (p5) is 'Rental Income by Trade Sector Mix' before FRS116 straight-lining: Healthcare 89.4%, Hospitality 5.6%, Retail 5.0%. pct_basis = rental_income.
Top-tenant table (p5) lists ALL 11 tenants (= 100% of rental income); First REIT has only 11 tenants. No trade-sector column — industry assigned from tenant identity.
